ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 92% high-intensity pixels (white) and 8% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) concentrated on the perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across the central and inner lobe areas. A prominent low-intensity (black) elliptical blob is located in the mid-region of the right lobe. Continuous low-intensity banding follows the entire trailing edge. Small dark punctate markings are visible near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations. The left lobe exhibits deep, jagged vertical clefts. The right lobe shows a smoother, more continuous jaggedness with one significant indentation near the terminal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the lateral tips toward the median notch, while the overall visible fluke span follows a broad horizontal convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular white relief patterns (dimples) scattered across the mid-left lobe, indicating localized surface irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, horizontal low-intensity linear marks located at the central base of the fluke, intersecting the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, large dark oval pigmentation patch on the right lobe; significant irregular tissue loss/notching on the upper portion of the left lobe's trailing edge.
